title: PaymentPlan (split and multi-tender)
description: How one accepted all_in_total is paid: several tenders now (gift card + UPI) and/or tranches over time (token advance + loan + balance). One closed payment mandate and one Receipt per tender. Step-up and AFA are evaluated on the plan total, never per tender. Over the wire, a gateway that lists the capability in.bacp.payment_plan offers plans as PlanOption values and takes the chosen plan as a PlanRequest.

plan_hash.description: sha-256 over the JCS (RFC 8785) form of the plan's tenders: the array of {tender_id, handler, amount, sequence} objects (with tranche_id when present), in ascending sequence, without payment_mandate and without any response-only field. The same value in PlanOption.plan_hash, in a closed payment mandate's tender.plan_hash and in the ts_render's plan.plan_hash.

checkout_hash.description: Hash of the BPP-signed quote (the checkout), the same for every tender. It is not the accepted offer_hash.

amount.description: Greater than zero, even when the tenders sum to the total.

tranche_id.description: TermSheet payment.schedule tranche this tender pays.

rail_ref.description: The rail's own reference for the debit (for example a UPI RRN or a Circle delegation id), kept so that support staff can answer a call from one record.

status.description: in_doubt: the rail has not said whether the debit succeeded; while any tender is in_doubt the gateway MUST NOT release or refund any other tender. reversal_pending: a debit that did not confirm is waiting for the rail to reverse it by reversal_deadline.

reversal_deadline.description: When the rail's reversal of an unconfirmed debit is due: the debit time plus the rail's turnaround time (UPI P2M T+5, PPI on-us T+1). Gateway-computed and response-only.

psp_key.description: The idempotency key the gateway sent to the PSP for this tender. It is derived deterministically from the Idempotency-Key of the complete request and the tender_id, because the PSP never sees the tender_id. Response-only.

reversal_basis.description: Why the reversal of a debit that the seller never confirmed is due when it is: rbi_tat, when the payer PSP reports the debit as pending or as deemed (a credit-side timeout); then the message states the T+5 turnaround and the compensation of ₹100 a day that the RBI circular (RBI/2019-20/67, Annex, row 4(b)) sets. bacp_policy, when the PSP reports the payee credit as completed and only the seller's Beckn on_confirm is missing; then the deadline is BACP's own policy, and the message never states an RBI compensation entitlement. unknown, when the PSP's response does not say; then the message names the routes that certainly exist and says that if the payer's bank shows the payment as failed or pending, RBI's automatic-reversal and compensation rules apply. Present with refund_route.

refund_route.description: Who refunds a debit that the seller never confirmed: gateway_collector, when the gateway's own payment aggregator collected the money, so that the gateway can start the refund itself and the message may say 'started'; seller_collector, when the seller's collector holds it, so that the gateway can only request the refund from that collector through IGM, citing original_rrn, and tells the principal how to raise a complaint through UDIR; the message then says 'requested', never 'started'. Present with reversal_basis.

refund_allocation.description: Default lifo: reverse capture order, each tender back to its own source (PA MD 10(f), PPI MD 14.3).

atomicity.description: Hold or capture in sequence. On a later failure, release or refund earlier tenders to source.

PlanRequest.description: The payment plan an agent sends in complete.payment_plan, in full. Its tenders MUST hash (see PaymentPlan.plan_hash) to the plan_hash of an entry in the session's payment.plan_options[], or to a plan that the principal confirmed on the Trusted Surface; otherwise the gateway refuses it with 400 plan_not_offered. The agent never composes tender amounts the gateway did not offer or the principal did not confirm. Response-only fields are not allowed.

plan_id.description: The plan_id of the offered or confirmed plan.

amount.description: Greater than zero. Every tender carries an amount; an open-amount tender is refused.

sequence.description: Capture order. Stored-value tenders first, and at most one tender without a hold primitive, placed last.

payment_mandate.description: The closed payment mandate for this tender, with tender{plan_hash, tender_id} set and amount equal to this tender's amount.

tranche_id.description: The TermSheet payment.schedule tranche this tender pays. Only the tranche paid at complete is debited.

refund_allocation.description: Default lifo. pro_rata is refused with 400 until the question of its fit with the refund-to-source rule is settled (Q-40).

PlanOption.description: One way to pay the session, offered by the gateway in Session.payment.plan_options[]. It carries no default or preselected flag. The gateway-written description is read out unchanged on a voice channel.

plan_hash.description: The hash that a PlanRequest's tenders must match (see PaymentPlan.plan_hash).

description.description: One sentence, written by the gateway from its own templates, for example hi-IN "₹1,000 गिफ्ट कार्ड से और ₹1,160 UPI से". Counterparty text never appears in it.

tenders.description: Read-only. The tenders of the option, in capture order.

all_in_total.description: The total the tenders add up to.
